Topics · Meaning and purpose

Do I owe thanks for a life I did not ask for?

Thanks here is moral reasoning, not a tax. No one earned their eyes, and no one in pain is asked to feel it.

Part 1 of 3

﴿وَٱللَّهُ أَخْرَجَكُم مِّنۢ بُطُونِ أُمَّهَـٰتِكُمْ لَا تَعْلَمُونَ شَيْـًٔا وَجَعَلَ لَكُمُ ٱلسَّمْعَ وَٱلْأَبْصَـٰرَ وَٱلْأَفْـِٔدَةَ ۙ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَشْكُرُونَ﴾

Translation of the meaning

And Allāh has extracted you from the wombs of your mothers not knowing a thing, and He made for you hearing and vision and hearts [i.e., intellect] that perhaps you would be grateful.

Quran · An-Nahl 16:78

Translation

The hearing ear, and the seeing eye, Yahweh has made even both of them.

Original · Hebrew

אֹ֣זֶן שֹׁ֭מַעַת וְעַ֣יִן רֹאָ֑ה יְ֝הוָ֗ה עָשָׂ֥ה גַם־שְׁנֵיהֶֽם׃

Proverbs · 20:12

World English Bible

Begin with what cannot be denied. You arrived knowing nothing. You did not earn your hearing, your sight, or the heart you are reading with. Now a small moral test: when someone gives you what you did not earn, and you behave as if you made it yourself, something is off. Everyone feels that. The verse lists these gifts and closes on a word of hope: perhaps you will give thanks. If gratitude is fitting toward a person, the question is to whom, if anyone, it is owed here.

A question for you

When something good comes that you did not earn, toward whom does your thanks turn?

If you sayToward God.
ThenThen the verse is describing your own habit.
If you sayToward the people who gave it.
ThenThe book includes them, as the last part shows.
If you sayToward no one. I feel lucky.
ThenThat is an honest report. The verse leaves one question, whether luck is all there is, and nothing here presses it.
If you sayOn bad days I feel no thanks at all.
ThenThat is allowed. The third part is for you.

Part 2 of 3

﴿وَلَقَدْ ءَاتَيْنَا لُقْمَـٰنَ ٱلْحِكْمَةَ أَنِ ٱشْكُرْ لِلَّهِ ۚ وَمَن يَشْكُرْ فَإِنَّمَا يَشْكُرُ لِنَفْسِهِۦ ۖ وَمَن كَفَرَ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَنِىٌّ حَمِيدٌ﴾

Translation of the meaning

And We had certainly given Luqmān wisdom [and said], "Be grateful to Allāh." And whoever is grateful is grateful for [the benefit of] himself. And whoever denies [His favor] - then indeed, Allāh is Free of need and Praiseworthy.

Quran · Luqman 31:12

Translation

if you seek her as silver, and search for her as for hidden treasures; then you will understand the fear of Yahweh, and find the knowledge of God. For Yahweh gives wisdom. Out of his mouth comes knowledge and understanding.

Original · Hebrew

אִם־תְּבַקְשֶׁ֥נָּה כַכָּ֑סֶף וְֽכַמַּטְמוֹנִ֥ים תַּחְפְּשֶֽׂנָּה׃ אָ֗ז תָּ֭בִין יִרְאַ֣ת יְהוָ֑ה וְדַ֖עַת אֱלֹהִ֣ים תִּמְצָֽא׃ כִּֽי־יְ֭הוָה יִתֵּ֣ן חָכְמָ֑ה מִ֝פִּ֗יו דַּ֣עַת וּתְבוּנָֽה׃

Proverbs · 2:4-6

World English Bible

﴿إِن تَكْفُرُوا۟ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَنِىٌّ عَنكُمْ ۖ وَلَا يَرْضَىٰ لِعِبَادِهِ ٱلْكُفْرَ ۖ وَإِن تَشْكُرُوا۟ يَرْضَهُ لَكُمْ ۗ وَلَا تَزِرُ وَازِرَةٌ وِزْرَ أُخْرَىٰ ۗ ثُمَّ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكُم مَّرْجِعُكُمْ فَيُنَبِّئُكُم بِمَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ عَلِيمٌۢ بِذَاتِ ٱلصُّدُورِ﴾

Translation of the meaning

If you disbelieve - indeed, Allāh is Free from need of you. And He does not approve for His servants disbelief. And if you are grateful, He approves [i.e., likes] it for you; and no bearer of burdens will bear the burden of another. Then to your Lord is your return, and He will inform you about what you used to do. Indeed, He is Knowing of that within the breasts.

Quran · Az-Zumar 39:7

Translation

Tell them, ‘“As I live,” says the Lord Yahweh, “I have no pleasure in the death of the wicked, but that the wicked turn from his way and live. Turn, turn from your evil ways! For why will you die, house of Israel?”’

Original · Hebrew

אֱמֹ֨ר אֲלֵיהֶ֜ם חַי־אָ֣נִי ׀ נְאֻ֣ם ׀ אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֗ה אִם־אֶחְפֹּץ֙ בְּמ֣וֹת הָרָשָׁ֔ע כִּ֣י אִם־בְּשׁ֥וּב רָשָׁ֛ע מִדַּרְכּ֖וֹ וְחָיָ֑ה שׁ֣וּבוּ שׁ֜וּבוּ מִדַּרְכֵיכֶ֧ם הָרָעִ֛ים וְלָ֥מָּה תָמ֖וּתוּ בֵּ֥ית יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

Ezekiel · 33:11

World English Bible

A fair objection: a God who wants thanks sounds needy, like a ruler collecting tribute. These verses remove that. One says whoever gives thanks does so for their own good. The other says that if people refuse, God has no need of them, and that He is pleased with thanks for their sake. So gratitude is no tax paid upward. On this account it is a way of seeing truly, and it changes the one who sees. What kind of person do you become if you never thank anyone?

A question for you

Which is closest to how thanks has been presented to you?

If you sayA duty I was told to perform.
ThenThen notice that these verses place its benefit with the thankful, not with God.
If you sayA debt I can never repay.
ThenSome carry it that way. But a debt to one who needs nothing is a strange kind of debt.
If you saySomething that makes me feel better.
ThenThat is part of it, and the verses agree. They add the question of whom it turns toward.

Part 3 of 3

﴿وَوَصَّيْنَا ٱلْإِنسَـٰنَ بِوَٰلِدَيْهِ حَمَلَتْهُ أُمُّهُۥ وَهْنًا عَلَىٰ وَهْنٍ وَفِصَـٰلُهُۥ فِى عَامَيْنِ أَنِ ٱشْكُرْ لِى وَلِوَٰلِدَيْكَ إِلَىَّ ٱلْمَصِيرُ﴾

Translation of the meaning

And We have enjoined upon man [care] for his parents. His mother carried him, [increasing her] in weakness upon weakness, and his weaning is in two years. Be grateful to Me and to your parents; to Me is the [final] destination.

Quran · Luqman 31:14

Translation

Honor your father with your whole heart, and don’t forget the birth pangs of your mother.

Original · Ancient Greek

Ἐν ὅλῃ καρδίᾳ δόξασον τὸν πατέρα σου, καὶ μητρὸς ὠδῖνας μὴ ἐπιλάθῃ.

Sirach · 7:27

World English Bible

Now, a life you did not ask for. No verse asks you to feel thankful for your pain. Where people in the book are in pain, they say so, and they are not told to give thanks for it. This verse names a debt you can see: a mother who carried you, weakness upon weakness, then thanks to God and to parents in one breath. Gratitude begins with someone who bore a cost for you. If today you can find no one to thank, this page does not ask it.

A question for you

Thinking of a life you did not ask for, what comes closest?

If you sayThere is much to be thankful for, and I know it.
ThenThen you might say so today, to someone who has not heard it from you.
If you saySome days yes, some days no.
ThenThat is how it goes for most people who are honest with themselves.
If you sayI cannot be thankful for this life right now.
ThenYou are not asked to be, and nothing here measures you by it.

The same in the other books
